drug-test.name: Drug-of-Abuse (DOA) Test OEM
drug-test.overview: Custom drug-screening devices — single analytes and integrated multi-panel cups — built to your analyte panel, cut-offs and branding for workplace and clinical channels.

infectious-disease.name: Infectious Disease Test OEM
infectious-disease.overview: Custom infectious-disease rapid tests — dengue, malaria, HIV, hepatitis, H. pylori, respiratory and tropical pathogens — for distributors, NGOs and tender programs.
capabilities: Combined panels (e.g., dengue NS1+IgM/IgG, malaria Pf/Pan)

cardiac.name: Cardiac & Tumor Marker Test OEM
cardiac.overview: Custom cardiac and tumor-marker rapid tests — troponin, CK-MB, myoglobin, D-dimer, CRP, PSA, AFP — for hospitals, labs and clinics.

womens-health.name: Women's Health Test OEM
womens-health.overview: Custom pregnancy and fertility tests — hCG, LH, FSH, fFN, iGFBP-1 — for retail, pharmacy and clinical channels.
